About.title: About
About.body: Product-oriented software engineer with experience taking end-to-end web applications from requirements and technical design through integration and production. I build maintainable solutions with <highlight>TypeScript, React, Node.js, and APIs</highlight>, focusing on architecture, payments, performance, and reliable delivery.

highlights.1: Designed and developed web applications and modules with TypeScript, React, and Next.js, from requirements and technical design through integration and production release.
highlights.2: Designed and implemented payment and subscription flows with Stripe and NMI, connecting checkout, backend, and transaction states in production.
highlights.3: Designed and evolved frontend architecture and API integration patterns: application structure, reusable components, state management, and data access.
highlights.4: Optimized loading, rendering, and technical SEO to improve performance and user experience; automated CI/CD pipelines and deployments on Vercel.

highlights.1: Developed business applications and modules with TypeScript, React, and Vite, turning functional requirements into maintainable flows and interfaces.
highlights.2: Integrated REST APIs and backend services, implementing data handling, validations, loading and error states, and business operations.
highlights.3: Refactored components and reusable logic to reduce duplication and make it easier to add new features.

needThis.description: Development of an ecommerce platform with TypeScript and React, guest checkout, and an operations dashboard. Includes a Node.js webhook API that connects Stripe payments with Convex.

galloExpress.description: Development of an ecommerce application with TypeScript, React, and Next.js: product catalog, multi-location inventory, and an admin dashboard with authentication, file uploads, and a persistent cart.

slotly.description: Built an appointment management application with TypeScript, React, and Next.js. It combines an interactive calendar, customizable booking pages, client histories, and self-service cancellations and rescheduling. Clerk handles authentication, while Convex powers reactive data, transactional availability checks, and recoverable booking operations that prevent duplicate appointments. Includes an account-free interactive demo.
